verdict.rationale: The evidence only lists sign-in entry points ('Connexion à l'espace professionnel', 'Connexion à mon espace Finances publiques'). Nothing describes the authentication method, whether MFA is used, or whether account activation needs a mailed code, an in-person visit, or biometric checks. The identity-walls axis clearly applies to a tax portal with account sign-in, but there is no evidence of a remotely completable credential-MFA path.
